svg.title: Local-First AI Strategy Factory
svg.desc: Printer-friendly architecture infographic showing a synthetic brief flowing through n8n, FastAPI and Uvicorn, Ollama, quality assessment, human review, and approved Markdown output, with PostgreSQL as the authoritative application database.
svg.text: From synthetic business brief to reviewed strategy and durable artifact
Local · authenticated · synthetic data only · inactive and unpublished
How a strategy moves through the system
Primary runtime: n8n → FastAPI/Uvicorn → PostgreSQL · Ollama connects to FastAPI for local generation
Retained Factory SQLite file: verified rollback snapshot only — not the active application database
AI Strategy Factory v0.1 · Local synthetic lab architecture · Printer-friendly reference
PostgreSQL is authoritative for Factory application data
